sources.entry: nef - This Xcode extension enables you to make a code selection and export it to a snippets. Available on Mac AppStore.

summary.one_liner: An Xcode Source Editor extension that exports selected code as an image or clipboard snippet, converts Xcode Playground pages to Markdown, and builds Playground Books from Swift packages, using the core of the nef tool.
summary.what_it_does: The extension adds nef actions to Xcode's Editor menu. It can export the current code selection to an image file in an output folder or to the clipboard as an image. It can generate a Markdown file from an Xcode Playground page by reading its //: and /*: */ markup comments. It can also build a Playground Book from a Swift package, including external dependencies defined in that package, which is saved to a location the user chooses. Image output is customizable through a Preferences action. Each nef action can be bound to a keyboard shortcut in Xcode's Key Bindings.
use_cases: export code snippets as images from Xcode
copy a code selection as an image to the clipboard
convert Xcode Playground pages to Markdown
build a Playground Book from a Swift package for iPad
how_to_run: Download the latest binary from the Releases section (preferred), or install from the Mac App Store
Enable the nef extension in System Preferences > Extensions > Xcode Source Editor
Use the actions under Xcode > Editor > nef
Customize image output via Editor > nef > Preferences
notable: Exports code selections to images or the clipboard directly from Xcode
Converts Xcode Playground markup comments to Markdown files
Builds Playground Books from Swift packages, including external dependencies
Actions can be mapped to Xcode keyboard shortcuts
caveats: The Playground Book feature needs Swift Package Manager and disables the sandbox, so it is not available in the Mac App Store version; use the .dmg from Releases instead
Requires enabling the extension manually in System Preferences
